formal_statement: ∀ {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (side : V → Bool) (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (π : List (PEqualNP.Search.QLine V)) (M w : ℕ), PEqualNP.Search.IsResLinQRefutation F π → (∀ L ∈ π, L.length ≤ w ∧ ∀ e ∈ L, ∀ v, (e.1 v).natAbs ≤ M) → ∃ ρ : List (Set (V → Bool)), PEqualNP.Search.IsRectDagFor side F ρ ∧ ρ.length ≤ π.length * (8 * (2 * Fintype.card V * M + 1) ^ w) ^ 3
plain_statement: A Res(lin) refutation over the integers with s lines, at most w equations per line and coefficients of absolute value at most M gives, for any split of the variables, a dag-like Boolean protocol (rectangle dag) for the search problem with at most s (8 (2NM+1)^w)^3 nodes, N the number of variables. Standard conversion (Sokolov, STOC 2017). Chain link 2 to L-alg-004.
title: Narrow, small-coefficient Res(lin) refutations become small rectangle dags
